name: list_databases
description: Lists the databases in a ClickHouse Cloud service by running SHOW DATABASES as the authenticated identity. Returns only database names as an array of strings, with no tables, sizes, or other metadata; call list_tables with one of these names to see its tables and columns. If the query fails or the user lacks passwordless access to the service, result is an error object instead. Idle services are woken automatically and the call returns an error asking you to retry shortly; stopped services are never started automatically and must be started manually.

serviceId.description: ID of the ClickHouse service to list databases for. Obtain it from the id field of a clickhouse-type service returned by get_services_list.
